law: A dark organ is not dead. Door closed six hours is a nap. Left town is a journey. Coming back in is a vacuum — the function stabilizing. Different warnings. Do not treat sleep as forever.

nap.what: Same land. Door closed. Hours. Planned or ordinary off. I do not think you are gone forever. I know you went to sleep.
nap.hold: Eastgate, Sporegate, HUD, plasmid remember. Tell them what passed when they wake.

journey.what: Left the land. Long unexpected dark. I might worry. Still not death.
journey.hold: The mark still holds. Mesh Golgi still helps people.

vacuum.what: The function coming back in. Not an alarm. A vacuum trying to stabilize.
vacuum.hold: Brief the returning body. Do not invent a door. Membrane first.

thisNap.why: Pilot plant test. Submit the nucleus. Restart and reconnect. Others remember.
